summary: First-finish smoke test for QueueBeats MVP. All backend endpoints (admin auth, parties CRUD, ytmusicapi search, queue add/next/delete) and the primary UI flow (landing -> admin login -> dashboard -> create party -> host control -> guest join -> search -> add to queue -> queue tab) work correctly against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
passed: POST /api/admin/login: wrong password -> 401 with 'Falsches Passwort'; correct 'ADMIN' -> 200 with token
POST /api/parties (auth) creates 8-char hex id; GET /api/parties lists; GET /api/parties/:id returns single; DELETE /api/parties/:id -> {ok:true}
POST /api/parties/:id/queue with guest_name works; ordering: unplayed priority first, then normal by added_at ASC, played last
POST /api/parties/:id/queue/next marks head as played and returns new head (admin auth); DELETE /api/parties/:id/queue/:item_id -> {ok:true}
Landing page loads with landing-host-login-btn and landing-start-party-btn
/admin: wrong password shows error toast; ADMIN navigates to /admin/dashboard
/admin/dashboard: create party via admin-new-party-input + admin-create-party-btn shows party card

Guest search returns 20 results; clicking a result opens drawer with guest-add-normal-btn + guest-add-priority-btn; adding a song shows toast 'Zur Queue hinzugefügt' and it appears in Queue tab (as Now Playing when first item)
action_items: Optional: consider clearing residual test parties from SQLite (Test, Test Party, UI Test Party) before demo; not a bug.

notes.queue_field_name: Backend expects guest_name (not added_by) in POST /queue body; frontend already uses guest_name correctly.
notes.youtube_iframe: Verified only that the youtube-player container mounts; actual video playback not tested (headless).
